_comment: Zed does not currently support bundling custom file icons inside an extension.
This file documents the intended icon mappings for use with external icon themes
or for when Zed adds extension icon support.
Manual workaround: use the Zed 'file_icons' setting in ~/.config/zed/settings.json.

Icon names above reference VS Code / Octicon names commonly used by Zed icon themes.
Exact icon availability depends on the active Zed icon theme.
